release_notes:
- Nexus AI works for students without their own AI settings: before, every AI feature failed with "model not allowed". The Integrity Checker also runs through Nexus AI now.
- Trial and course licences show their AI allowance as a total for the whole licence, not per month.
- New: a red dot on "Check for updates" on Home when a new version is available.
- Home, Project summary, Library and Screening have redesigned cards with coloured headers and icons.
- On medium-size screens, Home no longer hides Quick actions, Calendar and Deadlines.
- Many texts that were hard to read are now clear, especially in dark mode: meta-analysis verdicts and help, the kappa badge in Agreement, Manuscript Reviewer scores, checklist progress bars, the Paper Draft preview and the task list in Project summary.
